verdict.rationale: BILL's own docs show AP running on the same platform as Spend & Expense: one API spans AP, AR and S&E. AP coverage includes bill creation (including bulk and recurring bills), bill document uploads, AI multi-line bill coding, and bill approval policies controlling which bills need approval, by whom and when. Vendor payments are documented by ACH, virtual card and BILL-printed-and-mailed check, plus bulk/mass and international payments. Missing for 10: explicit wire transfer disbursement documentation, explicit invoice capture/OCR or email-inbox ingestion detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
